caption: The drawing features a single, detailed depiction of a brown shoe with a pink interior, shown in profile view facing to the right and occupying the lower right portion of the image. The shoe has a slightly squared toe and low heel, with a visible seam near the middle and a gentle curve to the sole. Above and to the left of the main shoe is a simplified outline sketch of the shoe, seen from above and from the side, both rendered in light pencil without any color or detail. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white. The artist's name, "Melita Heymann," is written in small text at the lower left corner of the page.
title: Slipper
